title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms region pinning + audit logging fix
author: Arielle Chen
description: Motivation: customer audits and internal compliance reviews identified gaps in how RBAC v2 policies interact with KMS region residency constraints and how those constraints are recorded in audit logs. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at policy evaluation time, surfaces the selected KMS key and region in structured audit entries, and includes a small migration to backfill missing residency metadata for recent events. Changes are limited to server-side policy enforcement and audit plumbing; no public API changes. Summary of changes: 1) Enforce policy-level KMS region pinning in rbac v2 policy_enforcer (checks KMS key region against resource pinning rules and denies when mismatched). 2) Include kms_key_id and kms_region fields in structured audit payloads and ensure they're emitted for both sync and async flows. 3) Add integration test coverage for mismatched pinning and audit emission. 4) Migration script to backfill residency metadata in audit store for events in the last 90 days. 5) Minor docs update and a helm overlay to enable stricter audit retention by default for security customers. Checklist: - [x] Implement policy enforcement logic - [x] Wire kms metadata to audit logger - [x] Add integration tests - [x] Add migration and run locally - [x] Update docs and release notes - [x] CI green on main matrix Rollout plan: merged to main, will deploy to canary security cluster for 24h, monitor audit logs and policy denials, then promote to primary cluster. Related: ENG-31415 implements the policy operator; SEC-4020 tracks compliance acceptance tests.
commits: 3 commits: a1b2c3 - rbac: add KMS region check to policy_enforcer; d4e5f6 - audit: include kms_key_id and kms_region in structured payloads and serializers; 9a8b7c - tests/migrations: add integration tests and backfill migration script

Requested change: add a short buffer/retry in test harness. // Arielle Chen (2026-02-24): Added retry and updated test to assert eventual consistency. CI rerun passed. // Samir Patel (2026-02-25): Approved after verifying migration idempotency and rollback plan. Merge performed with squash on 2026-02-26.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 evaluation time; audit logs now include kms_key_id (redacted for hosted customers) and kms_region to improve compliance traceability; backfill migration provided for recent audit events.
